reviews.text:
Truly an amazing dog trainer. Teaches us all the major lessons to help our dog become more compliant. We are really feeling optimistic about the results we are getting.
Nicko sends us a summary each week of each of the lessons, so that we can practice until we see them next time. Highly recommend him.

Niko has been absolutely exceptional with our puppy Peach! He’s helped us build her confidence, establish a routine, and navigate the ups and downs of puppyhood. He’s incredibly patient, kind, knowledgeable, and supportive, and has honestly helped us mentally survive the puppy trenches!

Peach has grown so much with his guidance, and Niko has become more than just our trainer, he feels like a friend. We couldn’t recommend him enough!

We started working with Nicko because our dog was having some issues with reactivity. I wondered if a change in behaviour was even possible at age 9.

I am completely floored at how her behaviour has changed in just a few sessions. Nicko had the best tools and exercises that we could use on an every day basis and catered completely to our dogs form of motivation.

I have never been prouder on a dog walk than during our last session when Flokie was faced with trigger after trigger (cats, many barking dogs, a park full of people) and never went over her threshold. All thanks to Nicko!!

I had a wonderful experience with Nick over 3 training sessions. His approach and philosophy towards training dogs is clear amd effective. My dog ,Tula, really responded well and was quick to pick up the tasks. Also Nick is very patient and kind with the humans and doesnt make us feel self conscious at all as we try and keep up with our canine companions
Thanks so much Nick 🙏

We had the opportunity to work with Nicko after i got our new cockapoo, Latte.  Latte is a timid dog, so we enjoyed the private lessons as they are more convenient, and plans are tailored specifically for individuals.

After the sessions, Latte is now more calm, confident, and leash reactive. We are able to have him off leash when possible.

Nicko is a really gifted dog trainer! In just three sessions his guidance made a huge difference in our dog’s barking. He can now quietly enjoy the balcony more often without upsetting our neighbours with his announcement and alarm barks. He’s also walking more cooperatively. We’ve had a few dog trainers in other cities over the years, and Nicko’s in-home training has been the best bark for our buck anywhere. I think being home with 1:1 training made me and my dog learn much better than in previous group training. Bonus: our dog enjoys working with Nicko so much and gets such a good brain workout that he always takes really long naps afterwards.

We had an excellent experience with Nicko and would recommend to anyone looking for an excellent dog trainer.  We adopted Pluto, our rescue pup, when he was just over a year old.  He had pretty significant leash reactivity  around other dogs, which soon became our training priority.  We found Nicko through an online search for trainers around East Vancouver.  From the initial consultation call, I knew we were in good hands.   Over six training sessions, Nicko took us through a thoughtful progression—starting with sessions in our home, then moving into our neighbourhood, and eventually into a park with controlled exposure to other dogs. The gradual approach really helped build Pluto's confidence while giving us the skills to work with him effectively. Nicko was also very comfortable including our 8 year old rescue pup in the training mix, despite our focus being primarily on Pluto.  The improvement we've seen in Pluto's ability to manage his reactions around other dogs has been significant. We're especially grateful that Nicko didn't just train our dog—he trained us. He equipped us with practical tools and techniques that we can continue using as Pluto grows and progresses.
Nicko is incredibly knowledgeable, patient, approachable, and clearly has a genuine love for dogs. We always felt supported throughout the process and never judged, even when training was challenging.  I would highly recommend Nicko to anyone looking for a knowledgeable, effective, and compassionate dog trainer.

We had a wonderful experience working with Nicko to train our small puppy. Nicko was calm, patient and personable and we could tell from day one that he truly cared about us.

We really appreciated how he’d always send us a recap of what we learned in that lesson, along with training guidance so that we could consistently and correctly practice at home.

We’re so thankful that we had him as our trainer-he’s very knowledgeable and passionate about training dogs and owners. He was always happy to answer any questions and took the time to explain everything. Nicko helped us to understand our puppy’s behaviour and helped him become more confident and calm. Our puppy loved Nicko and was always excited to see him.

It was a real pleasure working with Nicko and we would highly recommend him!

After adopting a dog and struggling with some issues (reactivity to other dogs, recall, impulse control), Nicko was instrumental in not only giving me skills to handle these behaviours but, most importantly, allowed me to see my dog in a completely different way. Me and my dog are much more on the same page these days because I understand what motivates him, and what he’s trying to communicate. Thanks Nicko, it was a pleasure working with you!

We had 6 sessions with Nicholas for Rocco’s training, and I honestly can’t recommend him enough. Rocco had absolutely no formal training before, and we were on a very tight timeline because we were preparing him for crate training before our flight back to the Philippines. We truly thought it would be impossible, but Nicholas made it happen.

In such a short amount of time, Rocco improved so much. Not only did he help with the crate training itself, but he also helped us understand Rocco’s behavior better—why he reacts the way he does, how to work with him instead of against him, and how to build more trust and confidence.

Nicholas really set us up for success for Rocco’s flight back home, and that gave us so much peace of mind. You can tell he is incredibly passionate about what he does and genuinely loves dogs. His patience, knowledge, and care made such a huge difference for us.

We’re so grateful for all his help and would recommend him to anyone looking for a trainer who truly cares.

Nicholas has done an amazing job helping us with our two dogs, Jake and Pippa adjust to living together. We saw almost immediate improvement and have really benefited from his tips and training over the last week weeks

Nicko worked with us to train our rescue puppy, and in 5 sessions, helped transform her from cautious and scared to a well behaved, confident puppy. He catered each lesson to our puppy’s progress, and met us at our home for the training sessions so it’s super convenient.

Nicko also provided us the education and tools to become good owners, all the while being incredibly friendly and kind.

Would 10/10 recommend!

We started working with Nicko to help with our younger dog’s reactivity, and the experience has been great. We’ve been doing weekly sessions with both of our dogs, and the progress we’ve seen has been visible after each session.

Nicko makes everything easy to understand and always takes the time to explain what we’re working on and why. Our dogs absolutely love him, and it’s clear how much he genuinely cares about the dogs he works with. He’s knowledgeable, patient, and responsive whenever we have questions. He tailors his approach to each dog’s needs while working with both simultaneously.

After every session, he sends a helpful recap along with what we should focus on before the next one, which makes it so much easier to stay consistent with training. We’ve already noticed positive changes in both of our dogs and are really excited to keep working with him. Highly recommend!
Nick is fantastic! He is knowledgeable and breaks down concepts in a way that's easy to understand. After just a few lessons, both we and our puppy have learned a great deal.

Nicko has been a transformational part of our lives. My rescue pup, Orli, became extremely reactive after adoption which felt overwhelming and disheartening. Nicko came in gave such hope. His love of dogs radiates through him and his calm, reassuring demeanour is just what we needed. Orli LOVES him and is a new boy each time we meet. Nicko's schedule is flexible, he is always on top of communication and makes sure to check-in to see how we are doing outside of sessions which shows such care. He also provides emails breaking down training notes which is fabulous. Nicko is truly the dog (and human) whisperer. We are so fortunate to have found him and would recommend working with him to anyone with a new pup, reactive or not.

We’ve made great progress with Nicholas in just 10 sessions. Our dog Bowie is an 18-month-old Tamaskan (Shepherd–Husky mix) — very energetic and sometimes reactive.

Nicholas helped us better understand Bowie’s behaviour and gave us the tools and confidence to work with him. We’re already seeing a big difference — he’s calmer and much less reactive.

Bowie absolutely loved his sessions with Nicholas. Highly recommend!

Our 3-year-old rescue dog, Beni, is sweet but very fearful and reactive. Because he won’t take treats when he’s scared, training has always been extremely challenging.
After some years of ups and downs (and multiple training attempts) we were feeling pretty defeated.

That’s when we reached out to Nicholas, honestly without much hope. We couldn’t be happier that we did!

Nicholas has an incredible way with dogs. He won Beni over while maintaining calm, confident control, and the progress we’ve seen so far has been amazing. Just as importantly, he’s been training us, teaching us how to be clear, consistent, and firm in ways we were missing before.

The sessions are positive, structured, fun, and completely judgment-free. Nicholas is clear, confident, and kind, and it shows in both Beni’s progress and our own. We’re beyond grateful and truly excited about where this journey is heading.
Nicko is great - been having 1 on 1 training with our pup. He's focused, knowledgeable, and teaching us lots of skills to practice. Would recommend him to anyone!

Training with Nicko was great; we saw demonstrable improvements in our dogs behaviour week over week.

The exercises he gave us were clear and helped us communicate more effectively with our dog.

Would recommend!

I’m so glad we found Nick to work with as a trainer! Nick has been excellent at listening and making sure he understands the areas we want to work on with our dog, and his vast knowledge shows each time we’ve had a session together.

I’ve found myself excited to work on the homework each week, and it has been wonderful seeing progress so quickly with our mini aussie.

I’d highly recommend Nick to anyone looking for assistance with dog training.
Highly recommend. Nicko was vv helpful in training Bubs.

I’m sure we would have messed our little puppy up if it weren’t for Nicko 🤣 He’s such an amazing trainer! He’s so knowledgeable and passionate about dogs. Truly a pleasure to work with. Cannot recommend enough! …

If you need a trainer that goes above and beyond for you and your dog you are looking at the right place. Since the first minute Damian (our rescued 6 months old giant lab) just shut up and paid attention to Nicko. He has grow a big confidence on us to learn how to manage, work and train Damian. We went from having the loudest dog in the building to having the biggest sweet heart in the block.

I cannot recommend KRU enough! Nico is incredibly knowledgeable, friendly, and reliable, which makes every session productive and enjoyable. His expertise has made a noticeable difference in my dog's behavior, and his responsible approach ensures that both dogs and owners feel confident and supported.

We love his his methods and professionalism and plan to continue working with him for our pet and additional pets as well. He is truly a perfect 10 resource for anyone looking to train their dog, if you’re searching for a skilled and dependable dog trainer, look no further!

Nick is such a knowledgeable, responsive, and friendly trainer. He has a genuine love of dogs that shows. I have recommended him to my friends :)

Nick is very knowledgeable and he explains well during training. He is also very patient with my puppy Cupid. He followed up with me about Cupid's progress between training sessions. Cupid is so excited to see Nick (and his snacks) every …

Nick has gotten us through the hard part of puppyhood and given us tools to carry his training on after our sessions are over. He allowed us to set a few realistic goals that we wanted to tackle and with one session left we feel like we …
